bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed in the venue. All bags will be searched prior to entry, and non-clear bags will undergo additional search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking information is not explicitly detailed on the venue's website. It is recommended to check nearby parking facilities or use public transportation options.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Arizona Financial Theatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Arizona Financial Theatre varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Arizona Financial Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Arizona Financial Theatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Arizona Financial Theatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
